section.12: The Book of The At-Tatbiq (Clasping One's Hands Together)

12.name_native: The Book of The At-Tatbiq (Clasping One's Hands Together)

hadiths.text: It was narrated that Ibn 'Abbas said:"The Prophet (ﷺ) was commanded to prostrate on seven parts of his body and not to tuck up his hair or his garment
